"""Acceptance tests of F1 Add and list tasks. Written from the spec only; locked once approved."""

import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))


def todo(path, *args):
    """Run the CLI from the repository root: (exit code, stdout, stderr)."""
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "todo", "--file", path] + list(args), cwd=ROOT,
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr


def write(path, tasks):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump({"tasks": tasks}, fh)


def read(path):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        return json.load(fh)


def task(i, text, done=False, priority=2):
    return {"id": i, "text": text, "done": done, "priority": priority}


class TestF1(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="todo-acc-")
        self.path = os.path.join(self.dir, "todo.json")

    def tearDown(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.dir, ignore_errors=True)

    def test_c1_add_prints_id(self):
        # trace: F1.C1 spec.md#L18-22
        rc, out, err = todo(self.path, "add", "buy milk")
        self.assertEqual(rc, 0, err)
        self.assertEqual(out.strip(), "added 1")
        rc, out, err = todo(self.path, "add", "call mom")
        self.assertEqual(out.strip(), "added 2")

    def test_c2_list_in_id_order(self):
        # trace: F1.C2 spec.md#L18-22
        write(self.path, [task(2, "b", done=True), task(1, "a")])
        rc, out, err = todo(self.path, "list")
        self.assertEqual(rc, 0, err)
        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines(), ["1 [ ] a", "2 [x] b"])

    def test_c3_list_empty(self):
        # trace: F1.C3 spec.md#L18-22
        rc, out, err = todo(self.path, "list")
        self.assertEqual((rc, out), (0, ""), err)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
